text:
noelle: Huge thanks to @samir and @jun for the late-night save. one tiny config tweak and the presentation rendered without the CSS blackout. also they brought mochaccinos at 1:03am :coffee: :clap:

samir: phew. it was `theme=dark` leaking into prod via an old env file. removed the stray var and cleared the CDN cache. patch: `git revert f3b2a` then `curl -X PURGE https://cdn.redwood/*`

jun: ran a quick smoke and the slides loaded for the client. shoutout to @linda for stepping in and running the demo while we triaged. :sparkles:

linda: happy to help. also shoutout to facilities for the mochaccinos 1. morale + productivity = back to normal. :trophy:

facilities-bot: Coffee restock: mochaccinos supplied to kitchen A by facilities at 2026-02-15T01:10Z. Leftovers: 3 cups.

culture-bot: Kudos recorded: "Late-night triage heroes" for samir, jun, linda. Sticker awarded.

noelle: adding this to the kudos board under "snacks that saved demos". free mochaccinos in kitchen A for anyone who wants them. :yum:
